jobs.title: Software Engineer - AI Integration & Data Platforms
jobs.description:
Overall Purpose:
Design, develop, and maintain software solutions that enable AI-powered workflows, enterprise application integration, and secure automation. Build scalable APIs, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, Python-based services, and cloud-native components that connect business systems, data platforms, and AI agents. Partner with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to deliver reliable, secure, and maintainable solutions using modern DevOps practices, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and strong software engineering standards.
Key Roles and Responsibilities:
Typical tasks may include, but are not limited to, the following:
- AI-Enabled Software Development: Design, build, and maintain software capabilities that support AI-enabled workflows, including MCP servers, agent-facing tools, and application integrations that allow enterprise systems and data sources to be accessed securely and consistently.
- API and Service Development: Develop robust APIs, backend services, and integration layers using Python and modern service patterns, with emphasis on reliability, maintainability, authentication, observability, and clear interface design.
- MCP Server and Tooling Implementation: Implement MCP tools and server-side capabilities that expose business functions, data access patterns, and automation workflows to AI agents while enforcing security, access controls, and responsible usage guardrails.
- DevOps and CI/CD Automation: Build, enhance, and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps or similar platforms, supporting automated builds, testing, code quality checks, artifact management, deployments, and repeatable release processes.
- Cloud-Native Engineering: Develop and deploy cloud-ready services using Azure-based patterns, containerized workloads, secure configuration management, logging, monitoring, and scalable runtime architectures.
- Collaboration and Documentation: Partner with product owners, software engineers, data engineers, security teams, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into durable technical solutions. Document APIs, MCP tools, deployment patterns, runbooks, and engineering standards for long-term support and reuse.
Job Contribution:
Independently design, develop, and support AI-enabled software solutions, APIs, MCP servers, and cloud-native services using strong DevOps practices. Lead moderate-sized technical efforts, contribute to architecture decisions, improve engineering standards, and deliver secure, scalable solutions that accelerate automation, AI adoption, and business productivity.
What You’ll Need (Required Skills):
Hands-on experience with:
- Python development for applications, services, automation, or integration work
- Proficiency with general software engineering languages and practices, with the ability to work across modern programming stacks as needed
- API development using modern backend frameworks and secure service design patterns
- MCP server or AI tool development, including exposing structured tools, data access, or workflow automation to AI agents
- Azure DevOps, Git-based development workflows, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and release automation
- Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including code quality, modular design, version control, security, logging, monitoring, and documentation best practices.
- Experience collaborating across engineering, data, AI, security, and business teams to gather requirements and deliver reliable enterprise software solutions.
Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with FastAPI, FastMCP, SQLAlchemy, containerized deployments, or cloud-hosted Python services
- Familiarity with Azure services, managed identity, Key Vault, container platforms (Docker), private networking, or enterprise authentication patterns
- Experience with AI-assisted development tools, prompt-aware engineering workflows, agentic architectures, or LLM application integration
- Hands-on experience with LangGraph and LangChain for developing LLM-powered applications, agents, and workflow orchestration
Location: Bratislava, Slovakia
Working hours: EMEA
Contractual name of the role: Senior Specialist Software Engineering
University student

English - Upper intermediate (B2)

jobs.description:
You will lead the development and improvement of our Python backends for LLM-backed agent applications, such as chatbots, as well as the ongoing evolution of our Agentic AI platform.
You will provide technical direction for a team of Agentic AI engineers, define engineering standards, review architectural decisions, and support the team in delivering scalable, reliable, and production-ready solutions.
You will improve customer experience by stabilizing and enhancing existing solutions, including better visualization, automated validations, function calling, agent actions, observability, and quality assurance.
You will identify and implement new business requirements and translate them into sustainable technical solutions.
You will drive cooperation with the business and actively contribute to customer workshops, meetings, and calls. The ability to explain technical topics clearly to business colleagues and demonstrate a consultant’s mindset is essential.
You will lead technical brainstorming sessions, architecture discussions, code reviews, and pair programming sessions.
You will identify potential use cases for automation, Agentic AI, and data science. Innovative ideas are welcome.
You will actively mentor engineers, support their development, and promote software engineering best practices across the team.
We work in a HYBRID STYLE of working with the possibility of working from home , but twice a week we meet in the office in Košice or Bratislava for meetings.
The published salary is the minimum possible offer.
The starting salary may be higher depending on the extent of fulfillment of the employee's requirements (education, language skills, required practice, personality assumptions and skills).
University education (Master's degree)
English - Advanced (C1)
Your skills:
At least 8 years of experience building and operating production-grade software in Python, preferably using frameworks such as FastAPI, Pydantic, Temporal, and similar technologies.
Proven experience leading engineers, technical workstreams, or software development teams.
Strong understanding of software architecture, distributed systems, API design, asynchronous processing, scalability, resilience, and production operations.
Preferably strong knowledge of LLM and Agentic AI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, as well as Azure OpenAI and OpenAI APIs. Ideally, you have already built and operated a production-ready solution using these technologies.
Practical experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, in-memory databases such as Redis, and document or search databases such as Elasticsearch and MongoDB.
Proven experience designing, building, and operating RESTful APIs and web service applications in production.
Cloud and DevOps experience, including Docker, CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions or GitLab CI, and deployment to Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Understanding of production requirements for Agentic AI systems, including testing, evaluation, observability, security, cost management, and reliability.
You are comfortable making technical decisions, explaining trade-offs, and aligning engineers and stakeholders around a clear solution.
You are flexible, comfortable with changing priorities, and prefer working in agile environments such as XP, Scrum, or Lean.
You can explain complex architectures and technologies in a clear and accessible way to customers and business stakeholders.
You actively mentor more junior personnel and share your knowledge of software development lifecycle and best practices.
Fluent written and spoken English.
Nice to have:
German language skills.
Prompt engineering and LLM evaluation experience.
Familiarity with MLOps or AI workflow orchestration tools such as MLflow or Dagster.
Experience with Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, or LLM observability tools.
Domain-specific experience in telecommunications or finance.

Senior Research Engineer
to join our Tech team and help us bridge strong software engineering with applied AI research.

Build and lead software solutions across KInIT
Technical ownership:
Take end-to-end ownership of selected KInIT systems, leading architecture, implementation, deployment, operation, and long-term maintainability.
Hands-on development:
Actively contribute code across the full application stack.

Establish standards:
Introduce reusable patterns, tools, and best practices to streamline development across teams.
Knowledge sharing:
Share practical engineering expertise across the institute.
Modern tech adoption:
Bring the latest advancements in cloud infrastructure, software engineering, and AI engineering into daily workflows.

You won't be joining a conventional product team.
At KInIT, we bridge cutting-edge AI research with real-world engineering. You'll switch between building institute-wide systems and turning novel machine learning outcomes into useful services, giving you direct influence over both software architecture and engineering culture across the institute.

jobs.description:
About Piano
Piano helps the world's leading digital businesses grow revenue by understanding and influencing customer behavior. Our platform unifies analytics, audience segmentation, and commercial personalization in one system, enabling media companies and digital services to maximize the value of every user interaction. Headquartered in Amsterdam with offices across the Americas, Europe, and Asia-Pacific, Piano serves hundreds of global brands including the BBC, Deutsche Telekom, Nikkei, and the Wall Street Journal.
At Piano, engineers and data scientists tackle complex technical challenges at scale, from globally distributed systems and real-time machine learning models to production LLM and agent applications that are becoming the foundation of new Piano products. We embrace a culture of innovation, collaboration, and craftsmanship where you'll solve meaningful problems that impact millions of users worldwide.
The Role
We're looking for an
ML/AI Engineer
who enjoys turning real-world data into useful product solutions. You'll join our Data Science team and work across the full lifecycle: prototyping, evaluating, shipping, and operating ML and AI features across Piano's platform. This is not a single-product role. You'll move between LLM-powered content understanding, personalization and targeting, intelligent customer workflows, and the agent systems underpinning a new generation of Piano products.
You'll help build agentic products that reason over Piano's analytics, audience, and subscription data and take real actions on behalf of our customers. You'll develop new ML and AI capabilities, from LLM-based classification to classical ML models for personalization. And you'll help keep our existing production ML solutions healthy — models that serve hundreds of millions of users and are essential for our customers' businesses.
Beyond the technical scope, we're hiring for how you think. The engineers who will do their best work here are the ones who care about feeding AI systems the right information, validating what those systems produce, and optimizing for quality, cost, and latency.
What You'll Do
Design and build agent systems that power new Piano products — tool calling, multi-step orchestration, memory and context management, and the integrations that let agents act safely on customer data
Build guardrails and human-in-the-loop patterns so agents can take real actions on customer accounts
Maintain and improve existing ML pipelines, model training workflows, and inference services to keep them stable and performant
Build and improve classical ML models behind personalization and targeting
Investigate and resolve production issues when they arise — understanding the problem by analyzing logs, model inputs and outputs, identifying root causes, and shipping enhancements that continuously improve how our ML systems perform
Collaborate with data scientists, ML/AI engineers, product managers, and other teams across the company to deliver ML/AI solutions that solve real customer problems
Deliver clean, tested, well-documented Python code and uphold good engineering practices (Git workflows, code reviews, CI/CD)
You might enjoy this role if you
Are curious about how AI can solve real product problems, not just how to use the newest model
Like exploring data and turning it into something useful
Are comfortable navigating unfamiliar codebases and quickly building a mental model of how systems work
Care about building ML and AI systems that perform well and earn trust in production
Have strong data intuition and enjoy hands-on exploratory data analysis to uncover patterns, anomalies, and insights in complex datasets
Move fluidly between LLM-based development and classical machine learning, and enjoy having both in the same week
Want to work across agentic AI, classical ML, and data-driven product development
What We're Looking For
Must-have
M.Sc. in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, or a related field
3+ years of professional experience as an ML Engineer, AI Engineer, Data Scientist, or in a similar applied ML role with meaningful time building production ML or AI systems
Fluency in Python and strong software engineering fundamentals, including Git and modern collaborative development workflows
Solid understanding of core ML concepts — algorithms, evaluation, and model behavior — and the judgement to know when a classical model beats an LLM
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, cloud platforms (AWS/GCP), CI/CD, and observability tooling (logging, metrics, monitoring)
Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar), including prompt and context engineering, structured outputs, and tool/function calling
Hands-on experience with coding agents such as Claude Code
Strong analytical and debugging skills, with a structured approach to problem-solving in unfamiliar systems
Ability to communicate clearly in English and work with product and engineering teams
Nice-to-have
Experience with agentic AI frameworks, orchestration, and tool-use patterns (Claude Agents SDK, Pydantic AI, or similar)
Experience with MCP — writing servers, or wiring agents to internal tools and data sources
Experience with LLM observability and evaluation tooling — we use Langfuse, but experience with LangSmith, Braintrust, or similar is fine
Experience with optimizing LLM inference for cost, latency, and quality through context engineering, model selection, caching, and batching
Experience with ML pipeline tooling (Airflow or similar)
Exposure to A/B testing infrastructure for ML and AI features
Applicants must have authorization to work in this jurisdiction without sponsorship from Piano.
Why Piano
You'll work in a cross-functional team infusing Piano products with AI and ML, with direct impact on how notable global media brands serve hundreds of millions of users
You'll build agent systems that ship into Piano products
You'll get unusual breadth: production ML at scale, new AI feature development, and greenfield agentic products, in one role
You'll have real influence over the tech stack and the freedom to choose your tools
You'll collaborate with highly skilled peers across data science, ML engineering, and product, in a company that moves fast and values craftsmanship
Generous token usage budgets with a focus on getting value from coding agents
Flexible working hours, competitive compensation, and benefits
Laptop of your choice
Modern office with dedicated seating
Hybrid work setup

jobs.title: Data Scientist  (ž/m)
jobs.description:
Zaujíma ťa umelá inteligencia, machine learning a nové možnosti, ktoré prinášajú generatívne AI technológie?
V Orange Slovensko rozširujeme tím Data Science a hľadáme kolegu alebo kolegyňu, ktorí chcú svoje analytické a technické schopnosti posunúť na ďalšiu úroveň a pracovať na projektoch, ktoré sa reálne dostávajú do produkcie.
Budeš súčasťou tímu, ktorý navrhuje a nasadzuje moderné AI riešenia v prostredí veľkej technologickej spoločnosti. Získaš možnosť pracovať s najnovšími technológiami v oblasti umelej inteligencie, cloudových služieb a spracovania dát, pričom tvoje riešenia budú používať tisíce zákazníkov aj zamestnancov.
Hľadáme človeka, ktorý má dobré základy v Data Science, rád experimentuje, neustále sa učí nové veci a chce sa rozvíjať v oblasti AI technológií.
Čo bude tvojou náplňou práce:
Data Science a Machine Learning:
pripravovať, analyzovať a transformovať dáta pre AI a ML riešenia
navrhovať, trénovať a vyhodnocovať machine learning modely
podieľať sa na nasadzovaní modelov do produkčného prostredia
monitorovať kvalitu a výkonnosť modelov
podieľať sa na riešení analytických a prediktívnych úloh
Generatívna AI:
pracovať s modernými cloudovými technológiami
vytvárať a rozvíjať dátové a AI pipeline
spolupracovať na budovaní AI platformy a MLOps procesov
integrovať AI riešenia do firemného prostredia
podieľať sa na automatizácii a zlepšovaní AI služieb
Spolupráva s biznisom:
spolupracovať s odborníkmi z rôznych oblastí spoločnosti
identifikovať príležitosti na využitie dát a AI
transformovať biznisové požiadavky do analytických a AI riešení
prezentovať výstupy a odporúčania stakeholderom
Technické zručnosti:
Must-have:
minimálne 2 roky skúseností v oblasti Data Science, Machine Learning alebo Advanced Analytics
dobrá znalosť Pythonu a Data Science ekosystému (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn)
základné znalosti štatistiky a machine learningu
skúsenosti s prípravou, spracovaním a analýzou dát
znalosť SQL
skúsenosti s Gitom a základnými princípmi verzionovania kódu
analytické myslenie a schopnosť riešiť problémy
Výhodou bude:
skúsenosť s GenAI alebo LLM modelmi
znalosť RAG prístupov
skúsenosti s cloudovým prostredím (ideálne Google Cloud Platform)
znalosť TensorFlow alebo PyTorch
skúsenosti s MLOps nástrojmi
znalosť BigQuery alebo obdobných analytických platforiem
skúsenosti s Dockerom alebo Kubernetes
skúsenosti s vývojom dátových pipeline
Osobnostné predpoklady a zručnosti:
Hľadáme človeka, ktorý:
má chuť učiť sa nové technológie a rozvíjať sa v oblasti AI
rád experimentuje a hľadá nové riešenia
dokáže pracovať samostatne aj v tíme
vie premýšľať analyticky a systematicky
zaujíma sa o nové trendy v oblasti dát a umelej inteligencie
chce vytvárať riešenia, ktoré prinášajú reálnu hodnotu zákazníkom aj biznisu
Máš pocit, že toto je presne príležitosť, ktorú hľadáš? Ozvi sa nám a poď s nami budovať budúcnosť AI v Orange Slovensko.
Ponúkame príležitosť pracovať na zaujímavých AI projektoch v jednej z najväčších technologických spoločností na Slovensku.
Budeš mať možnosť rozvíjať svoje odborné znalosti v oblasti Machine Learningu, Generatívnej AI a cloudových technológií a zároveň sa podieľať na riešeniach, ktoré majú reálny dopad na fungovanie spoločnosti.
Vieme, že kvalitne odvedená práca si zaslúži odmenu. Aj preto máme pre našich zamestnancov prichystanú atraktívnu ponuku benefitov, ktoré idú ruka v ruke s našimi hodnotami a podporujú vyváženosť práce a oddychu.

jobs.title: Data Scientist  (ž/m)
jobs.description:
Zaujíma ťa umelá inteligencia, machine learning a nové možnosti, ktoré prinášajú generatívne AI technológie?
V Orange Slovensko rozširujeme tím Data Science a hľadáme kolegu alebo kolegyňu, ktorí chcú svoje analytické a technické schopnosti posunúť na ďalšiu úroveň a pracovať na projektoch, ktoré sa reálne dostávajú do produkcie.
Budeš súčasťou tímu, ktorý navrhuje a nasadzuje moderné AI riešenia v prostredí veľkej technologickej spoločnosti. Získaš možnosť pracovať s najnovšími technológiami v oblasti umelej inteligencie, cloudových služieb a spracovania dát, pričom tvoje riešenia budú používať tisíce zákazníkov aj zamestnancov.
Hľadáme človeka, ktorý má dobré základy v Data Science, rád experimentuje, neustále sa učí nové veci a chce sa rozvíjať v oblasti AI technológií.
Čo bude tvojou náplňou práce:
Data Science a Machine Learning:
pripravovať, analyzovať a transformovať dáta pre AI a ML riešenia
navrhovať, trénovať a vyhodnocovať machine learning modely
podieľať sa na nasadzovaní modelov do produkčného prostredia
monitorovať kvalitu a výkonnosť modelov
podieľať sa na riešení analytických a prediktívnych úloh
Generatívna AI:
pracovať s modernými cloudovými technológiami
vytvárať a rozvíjať dátové a AI pipeline
spolupracovať na budovaní AI platformy a MLOps procesov
integrovať AI riešenia do firemného prostredia
podieľať sa na automatizácii a zlepšovaní AI služieb
Spolupráva s biznisom:
spolupracovať s odborníkmi z rôznych oblastí spoločnosti
identifikovať príležitosti na využitie dát a AI
transformovať biznisové požiadavky do analytických a AI riešení
prezentovať výstupy a odporúčania stakeholderom
Technické zručnosti:
Must-have:
minimálne 2 roky skúseností v oblasti Data Science, Machine Learning alebo Advanced Analytics
dobrá znalosť Pythonu a Data Science ekosystému (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn)
základné znalosti štatistiky a machine learningu
skúsenosti s prípravou, spracovaním a analýzou dát
znalosť SQL
skúsenosti s Gitom a základnými princípmi verzionovania kódu
analytické myslenie a schopnosť riešiť problémy
Výhodou bude:
skúsenosť s GenAI alebo LLM modelmi
znalosť RAG prístupov
skúsenosti s cloudovým prostredím (ideálne Google Cloud Platform)
znalosť TensorFlow alebo PyTorch
skúsenosti s MLOps nástrojmi
znalosť BigQuery alebo obdobných analytických platforiem
skúsenosti s Dockerom alebo Kubernetes
skúsenosti s vývojom dátových pipeline

Hľadáme človeka, ktorý:
má chuť učiť sa nové technológie a rozvíjať sa v oblasti AI
rád experimentuje a hľadá nové riešenia
dokáže pracovať samostatne aj v tíme
vie premýšľať analyticky a systematicky
zaujíma sa o nové trendy v oblasti dát a umelej inteligencie
chce vytvárať riešenia, ktoré prinášajú reálnu hodnotu zákazníkom aj biznisu
Máš pocit, že toto je presne príležitosť, ktorú hľadáš? Ozvi sa nám a poď s nami budovať budúcnosť AI v Orange Slovensko.
Ponúkame príležitosť pracovať na zaujímavých AI projektoch v jednej z najväčších technologických spoločností na Slovensku.
Budeš mať možnosť rozvíjať svoje odborné znalosti v oblasti Machine Learningu, Generatívnej AI a cloudových technológií a zároveň sa podieľať na riešeniach, ktoré majú reálny dopad na fungovanie spoločnosti.

jobs.description:
Join the Data & AI Tribe and be a part of our journey towards becoming a data-driven and AI-native company.
In our AI squad, we focus on developing and delivering complex AI use cases and building scalable AI platforms for the entire organization while fostering a culture of know-how and best-practice sharing.
We are looking for a new member who is ready to grow with us and push the boundaries of what AI innovations can achieve.
Your Responsibilities
End-to-End Development:
Develop, deploy, and operate complex AI use-cases, leveraging modern engineering tools to optimize and accelerate the development lifecycle.
Architectural Design:
Design robust, scalable, and future-proof architectures, with a specialized focus on designing and orchestrating multi-agent systems.
Evaluation & Security:
Implement rigorous evaluation pipelines (e.g., LLM-as-a-judge, retrieval metrics) and enterprise-grade security guardrails (handling PII, preventing prompt injection).
Continuous Innovation:
Proactively innovate your technical journey by exploring new methods, algorithms, and approaches in the fast-moving AI space.
Value Delivery:
Drive value-focused and highly effective delivery across the business.
Knowledge Building:
Actively contribute to our centralized knowledge platform and participate in community sharing initiatives.
Cross-Functional Collaboration:
Collaborate closely with Platform, Data, and DevOps Engineers to ensure seamless deployment and resilient infrastructure.
Ambassadorship:
Act as a bridge between technical developers, end-users, and business stakeholders.
Your Skills & Qualifications
Education:
Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Production Experience:
4+ years of software engineering or machine learning experience, with at least 2+ years specifically dedicated to building and deploying AI/LLM systems in production environments.
Agents Domain:
Deep proficiency in agentic architectures, memory management, tool-calling, multi-agent orchestration, and operating agents reliably in production.
Development Stack:
Strong hands-on experience with relevant development frameworks (e.g., agent orchestration libraries, retrieval-augmented generation frameworks) and specialized tooling (e.g., LLMOps platforms, vector databases, prompt management systems).
AI-Assisted Engineering:
Proficiency in leveraging AI engineering tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity) to co-deliver use-cases. You must know how to efficiently co-work with these tools to enhance productivity and code quality, rather than relying on purely "vibe-coding."
Data Engineering Basics:
Solid understanding of data pipelines, unstructured data parsing, and ETL processes required to feed context to LLMs.
Cloud Infrastructure:
Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (including GCP and hybrid environments) and containerization (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker).
Programming:
Strong Python programming skills with a strict emphasis on clean, modular, and maintainable code.
DevOps & GitOps:
Proficiency in modern deployment and CI/CD practices using tools like Git, GitLab CI, Prefect, and ArgoCD.
Soft Skills:
Excellent team, collaboration, and communication skills.
Drive:
Self-motivated, continuous learner with a passion for technological innovations.
Language:
Proficient in English (written and verbal).

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Agentic Engineering
jobs.description:
P&C Re Engineering is looking for a Software Engineer to help build and evolve the AI and agentic systems behind our reinsurance business. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys shipping production software, is fluent — or eager to become fluent — with agentic coding tools, and wants to work at the frontier of applied AI. It is a contract engagement within one of our business-line squads.
Agentic Engineering builds and runs AI and agentic systems for reinsurance — across Claims, Treaty and Facultative lines — on the platforms the firm already runs. While this is a hands-on engineering role, it rewards a strong product and quality mindset: you will own the software behind a line's AI systems and lead its development toward genuinely agentic systems.
What you will do
As a Software Engineer in the team, you will build, evolve and run the software behind a line's AI systems — the services and workflows that LLM-based agents use. You will work day-to-day with agentic coding harnesses (e.g. Claude Code): breaking work into well-scoped tasks, directing AI agents to build and modify code, and reviewing their output with calibrated scrutiny — spec-first, tested, and accountable for what your agents produce. You will work closely with the Product, Architecture and Domain Delivery organisations.
If you join us, you will for example:
-Maintain, refactor and extend the line's AI applications and services in production
-Build agentic-friendly software: the tools, services and workflows that LLM-based agents call
-Design AI workflows that combine models, prompts, tools, enterprise data, and business logic
-Validate model behavior, outputs, and assumptions from a production and business-use perspective
-Design and maintain evaluation frameworks for AI/LLM systems, including test suites and human evaluation workflows
-Write evaluations and quality checks for agent behavior, and build in grounding and assurance
-Ensure reliability, scalability, cost control, and latency optimization
-Help bring new agentic systems into production
We are a small, senior and hands-on team working at the frontier of applied AI for reinsurance. Our focus on agentic engineering connects us: we invest in the tools and patterns that let a small team deliver outsized impact, and we expect everyone to share what they learn
• Attractive performance-based bonus

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Agentic Engineering
jobs.description:
P&C Re Engineering is looking for a Software Engineer to help build and evolve the AI and agentic systems behind our reinsurance business. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys shipping production software, is fluent — or eager to become fluent — with agentic coding tools, and wants to work at the frontier of applied AI. It is a contract engagement within one of our business-line squads.
Agentic Engineering builds and runs AI and agentic systems for reinsurance — across Claims, Treaty and Facultative lines — on the platforms the firm already runs. While this is a hands-on engineering role, it rewards a strong product and quality mindset: you will own the software behind a line's AI systems and lead its development toward genuinely agentic systems.
What you will do
As a Software Engineer in the team, you will build, evolve and run the software behind a line's AI systems — the services and workflows that LLM-based agents use. You will work day-to-day with agentic coding harnesses (e.g. Claude Code): breaking work into well-scoped tasks, directing AI agents to build and modify code, and reviewing their output with calibrated scrutiny — spec-first, tested, and accountable for what your agents produce. You will work closely with the Product, Architecture and Domain Delivery organisations.
If you join us, you will for example:
-Maintain, refactor and extend the line's AI applications and services in production
-Build agentic-friendly software: the tools, services and workflows that LLM-based agents call
-Design AI workflows that combine models, prompts, tools, enterprise data, and business logic
-Validate model behavior, outputs, and assumptions from a production and business-use perspective
-Design and maintain evaluation frameworks for AI/LLM systems, including test suites and human evaluation workflows
-Write evaluations and quality checks for agent behavior, and build in grounding and assurance
-Ensure reliability, scalability, cost control, and latency optimization
-Help bring new agentic systems into production
We are a small, senior and hands-on team working at the frontier of applied AI for reinsurance. Our focus on agentic engineering connects us: we invest in the tools and patterns that let a small team deliver outsized impact, and we expect everyone to share what they learn
• Attractive performance-based bonus
• Ultra flexible working time in a hybrid setup, allowing you to work from home up to 50%
• Health & wellbeing program, including massages and sport activities
• Sessions with a psychologist and health check-ups directly at the workplace
• Modern office spaces in an attractive location (fun room, relaxation room, music room)
• Vivid community life (running club, book club, art club, Parents@SwissRe, and many others)
• 5 additional days of holiday
• 6 sick days and extra sick leave support
• Day off dedicated to volunteering
• Lunch allowance fully paid by Swiss Re
• Pension contribution
• Life insurance (fully covered)
• Learning and development opportunities
• Legendary summer event
• Public transport benefit
• Multisport card and corporate discounts
We provide feedback to all candidates via email. If you have not heard back from us, please check your spam folder.
Please use the link below to upload your CV in English.
We are looking forward to your application!
University education (Bachelor's degree)
University education (Master's degree)

English - Upper intermediate (B2)
About you
Nobody is perfect and meets 100% of the requirements. If you meet many of the criteria below and are excited to build production AI systems with agentic tooling, we would be happy to meet you.
In order to be successful in the role, you bring:
-Strong software engineering: a modern language (Python, TypeScript, or Java / Kotlin), clean code, automated testing, CI/CD
-A Forward Deployed Engineer mindset — a desire to understand the business problem, the impact the solution makes, and to drive pragmatic decisions towards realising it
-API / service / integration engineering
-Familiarity with LLM application patterns (prompting, retrieval-augmented generation, tool / function calling) and an appetite for agentic development
-Comfort working with agentic coding harnesses (e.g. Claude Code) — directing AI agents and reviewing generated code — and in a Linux / cloud environment
-The ability to pick up and improve an existing codebase
-Exposure to Data Science methods in validating AI models
It is a strong plus if you also have:
-Hands-on agentic / LLM application development (agent loops, evaluations, tool design)
-Experience with Palantir Foundry / AIP (valued, not required)
-Insurance or reinsurance domain exposure
-Experience with cloud AI services (e.g. Azure AI)
Even if you do not tick every box, but are eager to grow into this role and work at the frontier of agentic engineering, we encourage you to apply.
Thank you for taking the time to read our job advertisement. We look forward to getting to know you.
Swiss Re is one of the world's leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to aging populations and cybercrime. Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, where we were founded in 1863, the Swiss Re operates through a network of around 70 offices globally. Our approximately 15'000 employees provide a wide range of technical expertise, enabling us to develop unique solutions and drive growth. Swiss Re Slovakia is the second largest location with various teams in Finance, IT, Business Operations, Asset Management, and other functions. jobs.title: AI/Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Hľadáme človeka, ktorý chce nasadzovať automatizácie a stavať AI agentov v jednom z najväčších slovenských e-commerce biznisov.
Náplňou práce bude prenášanie aplikácií a agentov vytvorených v Claude Cowork a Claude Code z prostredia jednotlivých tímov do produkčného prostredia pre celú firmu. Súčasťou pozície je práca s GitLabom, kontajnermi a nastavovanie deployment pipeline.
Popri tom bude mať táto rola na starosti aj vývoj a realizáciu vlastných, komplexnejších AI projektov od nuly, napríklad generovanie produktového obsahu, spracovanie zákazníckej komunikácie či automatizáciu interných procesov.
Ide o prvú pozíciu svojho druhu vo firme. Spolupráca bude prebiehať naprieč IT infraštruktúrou, dátovým tímom, marketingom, produktovým oddelením, zákazníckou podporou aj financiami. Pozícia ponúka vysokú mieru samostatnosti a voľnosti pri navrhovaní a implementácii riešení.
Hľadáme prakticky orientovaného generalistu alebo generalistku, ktorý/ktorá dokáže prečítať a upraviť kód vygenerovaný AI modelom, nasadiť aplikáciu na Linux server a prepojiť ju s dátovými zdrojmi. Dôležitý je pragmatický prístup a schopnosť využívať AI agentov tam, kde prinášajú reálnu hodnotu, a v ostatných prípadoch sa oprieť o automatizáciu. Očakávame skúsenosti s projektmi, ktoré sú reálne nasadené a používané. Rovnako dôležitá je ochota spolupracovať s kolegami a kolegyňami z marketingu, zákazníckej podpory či ďalších tímov a porozumieť ich procesom.
Popis pracovného miesta:
Tvorba automatizácií firemných procesov s využitím AI na platformách ako n8n, Make a Power Automate
Nasadzovanie AI agentov na naše servery, sprístupnenie chat UI a budovanie ich bázy znalostí
Vedenie väčších AI projektov od zadania po nasadenie - automatické generovanie obsahu na produktových stránkach, systém na tagovanie a návrh odpovedí pre zákaznícke e-maily
Prenášanie aplikácií, ktoré si kolegovia postavili v Claude Cowork a Claude Code do produkcie - optimalizácia kódu, verziovanie v GitLabe, code review
Príprava virtuálok na našej infraštruktúre, nasadenie aplikácií a vytvorenie deployment procesu - CI/CD, staging, rollback, logy, alerty, zálohy
Napájanie aplikácií na dátové zdroje - náš dátový sklad, BigQuery dodávateľa, externé API
Tvorba šablón a jednotného štandardu nasadenia aplikácii a agentov
Meranie prínosu nasadených automatizácií a sledovanie nákladov na AI nástroje a tokeny
Používanie našej CI/CD pipeliny a DevOps praktík
Máš možnosť pracovať s flexibilným pracovným časom a home officom 2-krát týždenne.
Získavaš zľavy na veselé Dedoles produkty, ktoré ti určite spravia deň ešte veselší a farebnejší.
Ak by si potreboval/a podporu, môžeš využiť náš program podpory psychologickej pomoci, kde ti bude poskytnutá profesionálna pomoc a podpora.
Získavaš extra dni voľna, aby si si mohol/a užiť čas so svojimi blízkymi alebo si jednoducho oddýchnuť od práce.
Ak sa radi hýbete, môžeš využiť Multisport kartu a tráviť svoj voľný čas aktívnym štýlom života.
A navyše, zaručujeme stravné nad rámec zákona, aby si mal/a dostatočnú energiu na plnenie svojich pracovných úloh.

We are looking for a Senior AI Solutions Engineer to join our Group Security Management team and help design, build, and scale enterprise AI solutions that deliver measurable business value.
In this role, you will work at the intersection of AI, business processes, and enterprise technology. You will collaborate with process owners and stakeholders across Security, Resilience, Risk, and Assurance functions to identify opportunities, solve complex challenges, and implement AI-powered solutions that enhance decision-making, automate workflows, and support business-critical processes.

Junior Data Scientist – ideal for fresh graduates!
#LI-Hybrid
We have data.
We have cutting-edge technology and analytics tools.
We need an enthusiastic individual to deal with business challenges and make a difference.
We need an extra pair of hands and creative mind in our young dynamic team.
Interested? Give it a try. We need you!
Your role
As a Junior Data Scientist, your main tasks will involve:
Understand business problems and structure analytical approaches to solve them.
Generate proofs of concept from data that help deliver improved business results.
Prepare and pre-process datasets needed to deliver analytical solutions.
Generate distinctive risk insights that deliver improved business results.
Build and implement predictive models and other analytical solutions using both structured and unstructured data.
Collaborate with Data Engineers to deploy models into production environments and monitor models performance.
Support communication of findings, implications, and performance of the models to business stakeholders.
Your Skills and Experience
As a Junior Data Scientist, your skills and experience will ideally include:
University education (Bachelor’s degree or higher).
Ideal for fresh graduates or students finishing their degree.
Working knowledge of Python and basic data science packages.
Passion working with data and developing insights for use in business decisions.
Strong problem-solving skills and analytical thinking.
Strong verbal and written communication skills, especially the ability to translate technical results for business audiences.
English – B2 or better.
Experience with Azure and Databricks is an advantage.
Experience with basic NLP concepts and large language models is an advantage.
Experience with SQL and other programming languages is an advantage.

Life insurance from Zurich Austria, Compensation for salary loss during sick leave, 3rd pension pillar contribution, Risk Life Insurance, Meal contribution on top of the legally required minimum, Years of service bonus, Wedding bonus, Baby bonus
Other benefits
Electronic cafeteria, Maternity leave benefits, Massages in the office
Learning/Development
Professional Certifications, Online Education Portals, Extensive Onboarding program, Strengths based culture (GALLUP)

Bratislava office or Kosice co-working space

We would be happy to meet you in the office/ co-working space 3 times a week with the added flexibility of working from home on a weekly basis.

Full-time

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.description:
Senior Data Scientist
The Future Begins Here
At Takeda, we are creating a future-ready organization that uses data and digital to meet the needs of patients, our people, and the planet. We need your help to make this happen. Join our new Innovation Capability Center (ICC) in Bratislava, Slovakia.
In this role at our state-of-the-art center, you will have the opportunity to grow your skills and create solutions that will benefit patients around the world. Become the heart of our internal innovation engine.
At Takeda we unite in diversity
Takeda is committed to creating an inclusive workplace, where individuals are recognized for the diverse backgrounds and abilities they bring to our company. We are continually improving workplace experience and accessibility for everyone, and welcome applications from all qualified candidates. Here, you will feel welcomed, respected, and valued as an important contributor to our Team.
The Opportunity
We are seeking a Senior Data Scientist to design and implement the AI/ML strategy across Manufacturing Sciences, working in close partnership with Manufacturing Sciences domain leaders to translate strategic priorities into scalable and compliant solutions. You will design AI/ML roadmaps, drive adoption of advanced analytics, and mentor data scientists, and influence analytics direction across Manufacturing Sciences to deliver measurable operational impact. You will also shape manufacturing AI/ML strategy, lead cutting-edge projects, and directly impact global manufacturing operations in a collaborative, innovative environment.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
•	Lead global AI/ML initiatives across 20+ manufacturing facilities in alignment with Manufacturing Sciences strategic priorities
•	Architect AI platforms integrating real-time manufacturing data with cloud MLOps environments.
•	Drive innovation in AI/ML manufacturing optimization and autonomous process control.
•	Establish standards for model governance, bias mitigation, and regulatory compliance.
•	Mentor data scientists and collaborate with Manufacturing Sciences SMEs, IT, engineering and quality business functions.
•	Translate emerging AI/ML trends into practical applications that support Manufacturing Sciences decision-making and operational goals.
What Takeda Can Offer You
At Takeda, you may build your career, while contributing to better people’s lives. Expect trust driven culture built around Integrity, Fairness, Honesty and Perseverance. Joining ICC will give you access to high end technology, training and colleagues who will support your growth.
Benefits
Here are a few benefits our employees are enjoying at Takeda. To get a full picture of what we are offering, go to our Benefits page (button above).
• Cafeteria
• Medical - High standard medical care
• Bridge days
• Summer Hours
• Multisport Card
University education (Bachelor's degree)
University education (Master's degree)
Postgraduate (Doctorate)
English - Upper intermediate (B2)
Essential Experience Requirements:
•	Master’s or Ph.D. in Data Science, CS, Engineering, or related STEM.
•	5+ years in AI/data science roles, including demonstrated technical and people leadership.
•	Advanced ML/AI expertise experience (Classical ML: KNN, SVM, Random Forest/GBMs etc.). Deep learning: CNNs/RNNs/GRU, autoencoders, Backprop/Autodiff and experience with MLOps at scale.
•	Strong programming skills (Python, SQL) and familiarity with distributed computing (Spark, Kubernetes).
•	Experience in regulated environments, specifically: pharma preferred.
Takeda is an industry-leading, global pharmaceutical company with an unwavering dedication to putting patients at the center of everything we do. We live our values of Takeda-ism – Integrity, Fairness, Honesty, and Perseverance – and are united by our mission to strive towards Better Health and a Brighter Future for people worldwide through leading innovation in medicine.
Here, everyone matters and you will be a vital contributor to our inspiring, bold mission. At Takeda, you will make an impact on people’s lives – including your own.
Takeda is an equal opportunity employer.
We are taking a giant step forward to create a future-ready organization that evolves at the speed of science and technology, to meet the needs of patients by seeking and incorporating novel digital capabilities, data, and agile methodologies. Our aim is to provide digital solutions that are personalized to each patient’s unique needs and health circumstances. With individual care at the center, we can support patients in actively managing their personal care journey – from the moment they are diagnosed through treatment and beyond. Our Digital and IT team plays an integral role in accelerating this exciting journey.

jobs.title: Industrial AI & Automation Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY
As Industrial AI & Automation Systems Engineer, you will identify, design, and help deploy AI-enabled improvements across manufacturing and business processes. The role is suited to a systems-oriented engineer who can connect operations, quality, maintenance, engineering, and digital tools to deliver measurable results.
You will contribute to digital transformation initiatives involving AI, automation, advanced analytics, and physical AI applications such as machine vision, smart sensing, robotics, or connected equipment. The focus of the role is on safe, scalable, and practical solutions that support improvements in quality, productivity, cost, delivery, and operational reliability.
MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES
Identify and support AI, automation, and digitalisation opportunities across manufacturing and support processes
Analyse production systems and workflows to identify inefficiencies, variation, and improvement potential
Develop and help implement AI-enabled solutions using data from manufacturing, quality, and business systems
Contribute to practical physical AI applications such as machine vision, predictive maintenance, robotics support, and smart sensing
Work with cross-functional teams to ensure solutions address operational needs and can be adopted successfully
Support digital transformation projects from idea through pilot, validation, implementation, and sustainment
Create dashboards, workflows, and decision-support tools that improve visibility and problem solving
Apply structured improvement methods such as Lean, root cause analysis, FMEA, and statistical thinking
Help ensure that solutions are secure, maintainable, and aligned with technical, safety, and organisational standards
Keep up to date with relevant developments in AI, automation, and digital manufacturing, and assess their practical value for the site
The role is not repetitive or narrowly focused on a single area. The successful candidate will work on a variety of projects involving AI, automation, data analytics, and the digitalization of manufacturing processes.
Occasional remote work is possible, up to a maximum of two days per month. However, no more than one remote working day may be taken within a single week.
A key aspect of the role is gaining an understanding of manufacturing processes through direct involvement on the production floor and collaboration with various departments. The objective is to improve efficiency through digitalization, automation, and AI technologies.
BENEFITS:
Background of an international company
Regular annual merit increase
Christmas salary
Allowance for transport to work
Lunches in the canteen
Social program: vitamin packages, Health & Safety Day, St. Nicholas Day packages, Christmas packages, etc.
Teambuilding events: Christmas party, Summer party
Day off for volunteer activities

jobs.title: AI Quality Engineer (M/Ž)
jobs.description:
• Pomôž nám definovať, čo znamená kvalitné a bezpečné AI riešenie.
• Hľadáme AI Quality Engineera, ktorého primárnou úlohou bude rozvíjať testovanie a evaluáciu AI, ML a agentických riešení. Pri tradičnom softvéri často vieme jednoznačne určiť správny výsledok. Pri AI riešeniach musíme hodnotiť aj spoľahlivosť odpovedí, prácu s kontextom, stabilitu správania a reakcie na hraničné alebo rizikové situácie. Tvojou úlohou bude premeniť tieto očakávania na merateľné kritériá, testovacie scenáre a praktickú evaluačnú metodiku. Zároveň však nehľadáme človeka, ktorý sa chce držať iba úzkej definície testovania. AI projekty sú často nové, nejednoznačné a menia sa počas realizácie, preto potrebujeme niekoho, kto vie ísť za hranice klasickej QA roly a podľa potreby priložiť ruky k dielu aj v ďalších oblastiach projektu.
• Čo ťa u nás čaká
• Definovanie testovacieho a evaluačného prístupu pre AI, ML a agentické riešenia.
• Spolupráca na tvorbe akceptačných kritérií už počas discovery a návrhu riešenia.
• Identifikácia rizikových scenárov, edge cases a neželaného správania AI riešení.
• Návrh a realizácia funkčných, integračných a regresných testov.
• Príprava testovacích dát a evaluačných datasetov.
• Hodnotenie správania AI modelov, agentov a workflow.
• Overovanie spoľahlivosti výstupov, práce s kontextom a stability pri opakovanom spustení.
• Interpretácia výsledkov evaluácie a komunikácia zistení vývojárom, architektom, Data Scientistom a Product Ownerovi.
• Návrh úprav acceptance kritérií, promptov, agentických workflow alebo guardrails.
• Tvorba spoločných testovacích štandardov a praktických pravidiel pre hodnotenie AI riešení.
• Využívanie automatizácie a AI nástrojov pri testovaní.
• Základom roly zostáva kvalita, testovanie a evaluácia AI riešení. Nepôjde však iba o kontrolu funkčnosti aplikácie, ale aj o hodnotenie správania AI, spoľahlivosti výstupov, práce s kontextom a stability výsledkov. Podľa potrieb konkrétneho projektu sa môžeš zapojiť aj do prípravy požiadaviek, návrhu riešenia, práce s dátami, dokumentácie, nastavovania guardrails alebo podpory tímu pri uvádzaní riešenia do praxe.
• Aký človek sa k nám hodí
• Si presný, skeptický a zvedavý človek, ktorý sa nespokojí s povrchným overením riešenia. Pýtaš sa na nejasné očakávania, dokážeš odhaliť slabé acceptance kritériá a nezameníš technicky fungujúce demo za kvalitné produkčné riešenie. Zároveň máš chuť byť súčasťou tímu, ktorý veci nielen kontroluje, ale aj aktívne pomáha dotiahnuť ich do použiteľného stavu a podľa potreby vie priložiť ruky k dielu aj mimo samotného testovania.
• Čo ponúkame
• Prácu na AI riešeniach a platformách s reálnym využitím v banke.
• Priestor skúmať nové technológie a premieňať ich na bezpečné, prevádzkovateľné služby.
• Spoluprácu s odborníkmi z oblasti AI, dát, vývoja, architektúry, cloudu a bezpečnosti.
• Možnosť ovplyvniť technické štandardy a spôsob využívania AI v organizácii.
• Podporu odborného rastu, zdieľania know-how a praktického experimentovania.
• Prostredie, v ktorom sa od ľudí očakáva samostatnosť, otvorená komunikácia a zodpovednosť za výsledok.
• Práca pre banku najspokojnejších klientov na Slovensku
• Bankové produkty za zvýhodnených podmienok ako aj príspevok do DDS
• Možnosti kariérneho rastu či rozvojového vzdelávania
• Priestor pre dlhodobú spoluprácu
• Dovolenka plus  až 5 dní dovolenky navyše, zľavy od rôznych spoločností či možnosť kúpiť si prioritné akcie Tatra banky
• Dôraz na fyzické ako aj mentálne zdravie  multisport karta, bezplatná psychologická podpora 24/7, dni zdravia a ďalšie

Podporovať a odborne usmerňovať kolegov v oblasti BI a dát.

jobs.description:
Data Engineer
The Future Begins Here
At Takeda, we are creating a future-ready organization that uses data and digital to meet the needs of patients, our people, and the planet. We need your help to make this happen. Join our new Innovation Capability Center (ICC) in Bratislava, Slovakia.
In this role at our state-of-the-art center, you will have the opportunity to grow your skills and create solutions that will benefit patients around the world. Become the heart of our internal innovation engine.
At Takeda we unite in diversity
Takeda is committed to creating an inclusive workplace, where individuals are recognized for the diverse backgrounds and abilities they bring to our company. We are continually improving workplace experience and accessibility for everyone, and welcome applications from all qualified candidates. Here, you will feel welcomed, respected, and valued as an important contributor to our Team.
The Opportunity
As Data Engineer you will be responsible for building and maintaining data systems and constructing data tables and data models that are optimized for operations and analysis, supporting several Business Function requirements and downstream systems.
Job Description
•	Develop and maintain scalable data models and pipelines using AWS native technologies to support increasing data sources, volumes, and complexity.
•	Collaborate with several business functions to improve data models and their quality to support the development of digital products, fostering data-driven decision-making across the organization.
•	Implement processes and systems to ensure data reconciliation, monitor data quality, and ensure production data is accurate and available for key stakeholders, downstream systems, digital products, and business processes.
•	Write unit, integration, and performance test scripts, contribute to engineering documentation, and maintain the engineering wiki.
•	Perform data analysis to troubleshoot and resolve data-related issues.
•	Work closely with Agile Scrum Teams, specifically front-end and back-end engineers, product managers, scrum masters and quality engineers to deliver integrated and scalable data products.
•	Collaborate with enterprise teams, including Enterprise Architecture, Security, and Enterprise Data Backbone Engineering to design and develop data integration patterns and models supporting various digital products.
•	Partner with DevOps and the Cloud Center of Excellence to deploy data pipeline solutions in the Takeda AWS environments, meeting security and performance standards.
•	Support and align with Data Trustees, Data Stewards, and Master Data Management functions following Data Governance principles.
What Takeda Can Offer You
At Takeda, you may build your career, while contributing to better people’s lives. Expect trust driven culture built around Integrity, Fairness, Honesty and Perseverance. Joining ICC will give you access to high end technology, training and colleagues who will support your growth.
Benefits
Here are a few benefits our employees are enjoying at Takeda. To get a full picture of what we are offering, go to our Benefits page (button above).
• Cafeteria
• Medical - High standard medical care
• Bridge days
• Summer Hours
• Multisport Card

University education (Master's degree)

•	4+ years of experience in data engineering, software development, data warehousing, data lake/mesh, and supporting digital products developing data products following FAIR data principles.
•	Strong expertise in data integration, data modeling, and modern database technologies (GraphQL, SQL, No-SQL, python, pySpark) and AWS cloud technologies (e.g., DMS, Lambda, Databricks, SQS, Step Functions, Data Streaming).
•	Extensive experience in DBA, schema design & dimensional modeling, and SQL optimization.
•	Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

•	Knowledge of SDLC Proficiency with version control (e.g., Git, GitHub, GitLab) and familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions)

•	Familiarity with relational and non-relational databases (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB).
Takeda is an industry-leading, global pharmaceutical company with an unwavering dedication to putting patients at the center of everything we do. We live our values of Takeda-ism – Integrity, Fairness, Honesty, and Perseverance – and are united by our mission to strive towards Better Health and a Brighter Future for people worldwide through leading innovation in medicine.
Here, everyone matters and you will be a vital contributor to our inspiring, bold mission. At Takeda, you will make an impact on people’s lives – including your own.
Takeda is an equal opportunity employer.
We are taking a giant step forward to create a future-ready organization that evolves at the speed of science and technology, to meet the needs of patients by seeking and incorporating novel digital capabilities, data, and agile methodologies. Our aim is to provide digital solutions that are personalized to each patient’s unique needs and health circumstances. With individual care at the center, we can support patients in actively managing their personal care journey – from the moment they are diagnosed through treatment and beyond. Our Digital and IT team plays an integral role in accelerating this exciting journey.
